name: Potion of Growth
summary: A potion that grows you as the enlarge effect of Enlarge/Reduce.

stats.effect:
When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the *{ref:spell/enlarge-reduce}* spell for 10 minutes (no Concentration required).

The red in the potion's liquid continuously expands from a tiny bead to color the clear liquid around it and then contracts. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.
